title: Discovery of Pinostrobin as a Melanogenic Agent in cAMP/PKA and p38 MAPK Signaling Pathway.
authors: Yoon, Jeong-Hyun; Youn, Kumju; Jun, Mira
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮类化合物pinostrobin通过cAMP/PKA和p38通路促进黑色素生成，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Melanogenesis is the process of melanin synthesis to protect the skin against ultraviolet radiation and other external stresses. The loss of skin pigmentation is closely related to depigmented skin disorders. The melanogenic effects of pinostrobin, an active flavanone found in honey, were evaluated. B16F10 cells were used for melanin content, tyrosinase activity, and the expression of melanogenesis-related markers. Moreover, computational simulations were performed to predict docking and pharmacokinetics. Pinostrobin increased melanin levels and tyrosinase activity by stimulating the expression of melanogenic regulatory factors including tyrosinase, tyrosinase-related protein (TRP) 1 and microphthalmia transcription factor (MITF). Specifically, the phosphorylation of cAMP response element binding (CREB) involved in the MITF activation was augmented by pinostrobin. Moreover, the compound upregulated the beta-catenin by cAMP/PKA-mediated GSK-3beta inactivation. Co-treatment with a PKA inhibitor, inhibited melanin production, tyrosinase activity, and expression of MITF, p-CREB, p-GSK-3beta and p-beta-catenin, demonstrating that pinostrobin-stimulated melanogenesis was closely related to cAMP/PKA signaling pathway. Furthermore, the combination of pinostrobin and a specific p38 inhibitor, showed that MITF upregulation by pinostrobin was partly associated with the p38 signaling pathway. Docking simulation exhibited that the oxygen group at C-4 and the hydroxyl group at C-5 of pinostrobin may play an essential role in melanogenesis. In silico analysis revealed that pinostrobin had the optimal pharmacokinetic profiles including gastrointestinal absorption, skin permeability, and inhibition of cytochrome (CYP) enzymes. From the present results, it might be suggested that pinostrobin could be useful as a potent and safe melanogenic agent in the depigmentation disorder, vitiligo.
abstract_zh: 黑色素生成是黑色素合成的过程，旨在保护皮肤免受紫外线辐射及其他外部应激的影响。皮肤色素沉着的丧失与色素脱失性皮肤病密切相关。本研究评估了蜂蜜中发现的活性黄烷酮——松属素（pinostrobin）的黑色素生成效应。使用B16F10细胞检测黑色素含量、酪氨酸酶活性及黑色素生成相关标志物的表达。此外，进行了计算模拟以预测对接和药代动力学特性。松属素通过刺激包括酪氨酸酶、酪氨酸酶相关蛋白（TRP）1和小眼畸形相关转录因子（MITF）在内的黑色素生成调控因子的表达，增加了黑色素水平和酪氨酸酶活性。具体而言，松属素增强了参与MITF激活的cAMP反应元件结合蛋白（CREB）的磷酸化。此外，该化合物通过cAMP/PKA介导的GSK-3β失活上调了β-连环蛋白。与PKA抑制剂共处理抑制了黑色素产生、酪氨酸酶活性以及MITF、p-CREB、p-GSK-3β和p-β-连环蛋白的表达，表明松属素刺激的黑色素生成与cAMP/PKA信号通路密切相关。进一步地，松属素与特异性p38抑制剂联合使用显示，松属素对MITF的上调部分与p38信号通路相关。对接模拟表明，松属素C-4位的氧基和C-5位的羟基可能在黑色素生成中发挥关键作用。计算机模拟分析揭示，松属素具有最佳的药代动力学特征，包括胃肠吸收、皮肤渗透性及细胞色素（CYP）酶抑制。基于当前结果，可以推测松属素可能作为色素脱失性疾病——白癜风中一种有效且安全的黑色素生成剂。
